70010000133420.description:
You wake up in a strange place made up of endless red hallways. The exit is only a few steps away, but it's locked. To escape, you'll need to search the maze, solve puzzles, and uncover the key before it's too late.

You're not alone.

Something is wandering the hallways, and it's hunting you.

Features:
>Explore eerie endless red hallways.
>Solve puzzle to unlock the exit.
>Avoid a terrifying creature stalking the maze.
>Experience tense first-person horror.

Escape before it's too late.
70010000133420.intro: The exit is right there... but you can't leave.
70010000133420.name: RED HALLWAYS: Horror

70010000133682.description:
Test your parkour skills in a dangerous lava-filled obstacle course packed with moving platforms and deadly traps. Time your jumps carefully and make it to the end of every level without falling into the magma.

Think you've mastered the course? Try Hardcore Mode, where every checkpoint is disabled. One mistake means starting over.

Features
>Complete exciting lava-themed parkour levels.
>Jump across moving platforms and over molten magma.
>Use checkpoints to save your progress.
>Take on Hardcore Mode with no checkpoints.
70010000133682.name: Parkour Obby: Magma Run

70010000100080.description:
Deep within the forest, at the bottom of a well, lives the only creature brave enough to kill the queen... 

Play as Glimmer - a tiny bird armed with a matchstick- who must burn the wicked queen to save his family. Explore a dark fairy-tale landscape and befriend the charming characters who reside in the kingdom’s underbelly. Battle terrifying beasts and gain new abilities to expand your map. Solve puzzles, discover secrets, and unravel the mysteries that lie in this rotted kingdom.

Among the rotting ruins are a charming cast of characters just trying to get by.  Go camping with Ilda, a tiny mouse who is on the run from the queens grasp. Explore an abandoned castle with Looter, a mysterious scavenger who searches the kingdom for the best wares to steal. And find and reunite with all of your sheltered siblings who were snatched up one night by a crazed hunter.

Light up your matchstick to illuminate the world and aid in combat. Collect trinkets to upgrade your abilities, and mix-and-match them to customize your game play. Solve puzzles, defeat vicious bosses, and forge your path to the queens quarters to save your family.
70010000100080.intro: Well Dweller is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania, full of charming characters living in a wretched kingdom. Play as Glimmer, a tiny bird armed with a matchstick.
70010000100080.name: Well Dweller

70010000121717.description:
You are the Grand Inquisitor now! Restore the town and lead your undead army into battle to save the realm from a zombie apocalypse. Welcome to Graveyard Keeper 2 - the sequel to the original, unhinged classic!

Manage. Grind. Automate!
Build and manage your own medieval graveyard. Harvest as much flora, fauna, and human remains as you can to build extraordinary machinery, automate production, and expand your graveyard for pure profit.

Save the Kingdom!
Become the Inquisitor and lead your undead army into battle to save the Kingdom from a zombie apocalypse. Build towers and fortifications, craft powerful armour and weapons, arm and train your not-so-smart troops, and slash your way to victory!

Rebuild The Town. For Profits!
Help the townsfolk restore their homes and turn their problems into revenue. Complete quests throughout the city, as your undead workers take care of the heavy lifting behind the scenes. With zombie-based automation and structured systems, you can transform local efforts into a scalable and profitable operation.
70010000121717.intro: Manage your graveyard, rebuild the Town and lead undead armies into battles!
70010000121717.name: Graveyard Keeper 2

70050000079210.description:
Take a break from fighting hordes of zombies with a rejuvenating session in your very own sauna. Then slip into an exclusive outfit and show the locals who the true village dandy is.

The pre-order bonus includes:

- A personal sauna outside the player’s house
- An exclusive outfit for the player character
70050000079210.name: Graveyard Keeper 2 - Pre-Order Bonus

70010000104877.description:
BIRDCAGE is an arcade-style vertical scrolling shoot’em up inspired by genre classics, blending gritty pixel art sprites with 2.5D backdrops and a pumping retro soundtrack! Blast through 6 unique stages of bullet hell mayhem, facing off against enemy swarms using multiple shot types and rechargeable specials.

Chase high scores by maintaining chains and kill rate. Strategically activate Hyperblade mode in tense situations, and take down screen-filling bosses! Can you break free of your cage and redeem humanity?

• Blast through 6 unique stages of bullet hell mayhem!
• Enjoy retro aesthetics with 2D pixel art sprites and 2.5D environments.
• Strategically switch between spread shots and focused attacks.
• Charge homing specials and deploy Hyperblade mode!
• Aim for higher scores with attack chains and precise kill rates.
• Engage in a thought-provoking narrative and review memories as you progress.
70010000104877.intro: Break free of your cage and protect humanity from certain destruction in old-school shoot’em up style!
70010000104877.name: BIRDCAGE

70010000133718.description:
Welcome to the sento—a Japanese public bathhouse where the floors are slippery and the battles are anything but relaxing!

Slide too far, crash into your rivals, or get caught up in unexpected stage gimmicks. Anything can happen in this chaotic water-gun battle!
Master the slippery bathhouse floors, blast your rivals with water guns, and fight your way to the ultimate honor: being first into the bath!

Enjoy a full single-player campaign packed with unique stages, or gather up to four players for chaotic local multiplayer battles.

■ Take on 36 unique stages set in Japanese public bathhouses!
In the single-player campaign, travel through six areas inspired by different parts of Japan and take on a total of 36 stages. A powerful boss awaits at the end of each area!

No two stages are the same. Their size, obstacle layouts, and stage gimmicks all vary, so study your surroundings and figure out the best route to gain the upper hand.
Having trouble with a stage? Try switching characters or changing your water gun to find a combination that better suits the challenge.

Clearing a stage is only the beginning. Each stage also features three Challenges to complete for players looking to master them all.

■ Choose from four unique characters!
Four playable characters are ready to enter the bathhouse, each with their own appearance and abilities.
Asahi is a balanced all-rounder with strong offense and defense. Rei uses exceptional acceleration to chase down rivals. Teppei relies on his impressive toughness to overpower the competition, while Yuzuki uses speed and agility to keep opponents guessing.
Choose the character that best suits the stage—or simply pick your favorite!

■ Pick the right water gun for the job!
Four different water guns offer distinct playstyles.
The Aqua Shot is a reliable handgun-type weapon with balanced performance and fast reloads. The Aqua Burst is a shotgun-type weapon that fires water over a wide area. The Aqua Lancer is a powerful rifle-type weapon with excellent range, while the Aqua Storm is a submachine-gun-type weapon capable of unleashing a relentless stream of shots.
Experiment with different combinations of characters and water guns to find the setup that works best for each stage.
Complete certain conditions in the campaign to unlock new water-gun skins and customize their appearance to your liking!

■ Go wild with Special Weapons!
Powerful Special Weapons can appear during battle. Grab them before your rivals do and turn the tide in an instant!
If an opponent gets there first, you could be in serious trouble—but take them down and you can steal the weapon for yourself.
Win the fight for these powerful weapons and seize the advantage!

■ Stage gimmicks turn every match into chaos!
Jet showers bursting up from the floor, giant rubber ducks, and plenty of other bizarre gimmicks can throw your plans into disarray.
Why are things like these in a bathhouse?
Some mysteries are better left unsolved.

■ Up to 4-player local multiplayer!
In addition to the full single-player campaign, you can enjoy local multiplayer battles with up to four players.
Play solo, with friends, or with family—and embrace the chaos!

■ The Story
“At last, the time has come!”
Once every four years, the Grand Sento First Bath Festival is held!
Sento Masters from across Japan gather to prove just how deeply they treasure the sacred honor of Ichibanfuro (First Bath).
Pride is on the line, water guns are loaded, and only one can claim the glory of the first bath!
Show the world a passion for the bath hotter than the water itself!
70010000133718.intro: Master the slippery floors of a Japanese public bathhouse and blast your rivals with water guns!
70010000133718.name: SENTO SURVIVOR : Slip, Grab, and Bathe in Glory!

70010000094724.description:
COORDINATE OR CRUMBLE! To survive this mission, you'll need to grab a Joy-Con™ and get ready to swing into action. Take control of the inseparable duo, Ten and Tango, as they embark on a high-stakes platforming journey to topple the villainous Chef Murgó.

Don’t let the cute art style fool you—this is a relentless test of skill where one slip-up sends both octos tumbling. Whether you’re tackling the challenge Solo (mastering the "brain-melting" art of controlling both characters at once) or syncing up in Local or Online Co-op, your coordination will be pushed to the absolute limit.

WHY YOU’LL BE TANGLED UP:

DECEPTIVELY DIFFICULT: Master the timing of two octos holding hands. It’s quirky, colourful, and punishingly hard.

TANDEM TEAMWORK: Use your physical bond to swing across massive gaps and dodge lethal traps. In this game, you literally "carry" your partner!

DIVERSE WORLDS: Navigate windy deserts, crumbling lava mountains, and intricate puzzles that demand 100% precision.

PERFECT FOR NINTENDO SWITCH™: Play anytime, anywhere in Tabletop, Handheld, or TV mode. One Joy-Con per player is all you need for local co-op!

GLOBAL LEADERBOARDS: Think you’re the fastest on the planet? Prove it! Compete for the best times against players worldwide.

GAME MODES:
* 2-Player Online or Local Co-op: The ultimate test of friendship and physics.
* Solo Mode: A unique mental challenge where you must coordinate both octos simultaneously.
70010000094724.intro: Two octos on a precision mission! Swing through a cute but brutal world. Master the tango of teamwork solo or in local/online co-op. Can you defeat Chef Murgó?
70010000094724.name: Tentacle Tango

70010000105839.description:
Your beloved human has vanished into the night. As a pair of courageous cats, you’ll follow their scent to an abandoned mansion shrouded in fog and mystery. But this is no ordinary house — it’s alive with whispers, shadows, and secrets from the past.

Ghostly Whiskers is a short but unforgettable co-op (or solo) adventure that blends light horror with heartwarming moments. Solve puzzles, explore eerie rooms, and use your feline instincts — like squeezing through tight spaces, climbing ledges, and sniffing out hidden clues — to uncover the truth.

- Use your flashlight to reveal secrets in the dark
- Sniff out trails and memory fragments
- Explore a hand-crafted haunted mansion full of cozy, eerie charm
- Play solo or with a friend in split-screen co-op

In the end, it’s not just about chasing ghosts — it’s about finding your friend… and bringing them home.
70010000105839.intro: Two fearless cats on a cozy, spooky adventure.
70010000105839.name: Ghostly Whiskers

70010000106689.description:
《Story》
Tokyo has collapsed. In a city where reality itself is eroding, grotesque entities known as 《Aberrations》 roam the ruined streets.
While working as a simple delivery boy, Souma Hoshigami is brutally attacked by an Aberration—leaving him in a fractured, 'Half-turned' state where man and monster fuse into one. He is rescued and taken into custody not as a citizen, but as 'lost property' by Rena Hizuki, a lethal investigator from the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department's Public Safety Department, Foreign Affairs Fifth Division (commonly known as the Public Safety Mutation Response Division).
Step into the shoes of Rena and Souma in a world choking on reality-shattering contamination. 
Track down 'Tiny True,' the demonic narcotic flooding the streets. Uncover the truth behind 'Stigmas,' the cursed body-carved glyphs infecting the youth. Expose the mysterious cult pulling the strings from the shadows. Engage in fast-paced, hyper-stylish combat to slice through terrifying foes and unravel the mystery of a world tearing at the seams.

《Battle System》
Unleash total dominance with a refreshing, high-octane combat system. Master the flow of time itself as you stack and chain devastating skills to obliterate your enemies with massive, satisfying combos.

◆ The Timeline Innovation
Predict. React. Intercept. The combat interface features a dynamic, timeline-driven gauge that exposes the exact timing and nature of incoming enemy attacks.
Use this timeline to program your own skills, shatter enemy offensives, and take complete control of the battlefield.
Slow down time or pause the action at any moment to analyze tactical forecasts, track cooldowns, and execute precise strategies.
Whether you are delivering a punishing counter-attack or slipping buffs into the narrow gaps of an enemy’s onslaught, victory is determined by your strategic intellect.

◆ Master the Speed of Combat
While the timeline offers deep, strategic contemplation, the combat scales with your skill. As you master the mechanics, the gameplay transforms into an aggressive, adrenaline-fueled experience that rivals pure action games!
Will you play with relentless aggression, or stay cool and intellectual to dissect formidable bosses? 
Choose your combat style, slash through bizarre threats with unparalleled flair, and conquer the ultimate anomalies.

《Immersive Voice Acting》
Experience a fully voiced, gripping narrative that drags you straight into the heart of the crisis.

《Cutting-Edge Visuals》
Immerse yourself in a vibrant, cel-shaded art style paired with custom, unsettling shaders designed exclusively to bring the horrific nature of the Aberrations to life in spectacular, bone-chilling detail.

《Searing Soundtracks & Themes》
Ignite your battle spirit with a pulse-pounding opening theme and an electrifying lineup of in-game insert songs that will elevate your gaming experience to new heights.
70010000106689.name: Qliphah in Providence's Shadow

70010000115745.description:
Farming Camp is a cozy, single-player farm management game that follows the journey of an ambitious teenager competing to become the best farmer in the camp. Manage your farm alongside your companions, complete chores for points, and deal with the dynamics of a colorful cast in their teenage years. 

Your path to farming greatness begins!
Step into the boots of young Alessandra, before she became the renowned Evertree Farmer. Experience her life at the Evertree Farming Camp where it all began. Learn the ropes and face the fun and chaos of camp life.

Team up with a lively farming crew
You're not alone on the farm. You’ll have the company of two budding young farmers, each with their own vibe. Assign chores, solve problems, and build friendships as you figure out how to run the farm together.

Heart, humor, and harvests!
Farming’s only half the fun at Evertree Farming Camp. From delightful dramas to silly surprises, and even a few messy moments, there's never a dull day at the camp!

Work hard to take care of the camp
Use the tools at your disposal and climb your way to the top as the camp’s best farming team. Coordinate with your companions and earn points by completing chores, maintaining the camp, attending classes, and tackling missions.  

Have fun and win the competition
Jump into quick and fun minigames that keep things exciting—whether it’s racing against the clock to eliminate pests, chopping wood, cooking delicious meals, and more!

Key Features:
- Embark on a cozy single-player farming adventure and follow a unique, captivating story. 
- Explore a beautifully hand-drawn 2D top-down world full of charming details. 
- Meet a diverse and lovable cast of characters, each with their own quirks, stories, and farming talents. 
- Grow a variety of crops, care for animals, fish, and make your team win the competition.
- Keep your farm thriving with fun and engaging mini-games.
70010000115745.intro: Follow the journey of Alessandra competing to become the best farmer in the camp.
70010000115745.name: Farming Camp

70010000116096.description:
Manage an Adventure Park
 Build all kinds of facilities, such as weapon shops, general stores, and tailor shops, then assign the right Pupus to run them. The harder the heroes “adventure” in your park, the more resources you earn, allowing you to keep expanding your very own adventure park.

Raise the Pupu Clan
 As your park continues to grow, you’ll need more reliable workers. Breed new Pupus through the Spring of Life, build homes for them, and make cookies and cakes to keep them fed—yes, they absolutely love sweets! Of course, you’ll also need to take care of their little moods from time to time.

Unlock Facilities and Blueprints
 From basic shops to special NPCs like bards, merchants, and bounty hunters, keep unlocking blueprints to expand what your park can do. As construction goes on, you may even stumble upon the surprising story hidden behind this adventure park.

Post Adventure Commissions
 Post all kinds of tasks on the commission board to attract different types of heroes. Design your tasks wisely to maximize park revenue and obtain key resources such as rare items and hero essence, which can be used to upgrade and expand your park.
70010000116096.intro: Run a fantasy theme park where heroes get to play adventurer!
70010000116096.name: PUPU's Adventure Park

70010000117338.description:
Summer holidays? Adventure time!
No sooner has Bibi returned to Martin's Farm than the next big adventure awaits: the Summer Cup is starting at Falkenstein Castle. Together with Tina and Alex, you compete in exciting riding disciplines – and show what friendship, fairness and a little bit of witchcraft can make possible.

New: carriage driving!
This has never been seen in a Bibi & Tina game before: Bibi, Tina and Alex have their very own vehicle ready for the Summer Cup. Steer a carriage along country tracks, through flower gates and around tight slalom courses! After all, champions do not only prove themselves in the saddle.

Stephanie wants the cup. At any cost.
Good thing you are not on your own. Stephanie von Schotterburg has her very own ideas about how to win – and the closer the final gets, the clearer her intentions become. Now it is time to show what really matters: friendship and sticking together. And, of course, Bibi’s witch power!

Ride, drive and fight your way to the final
Checkpoint courses, show jumps, flag collecting, ring jousting – every discipline brings you closer to the final, and every mistake costs points. Timing, skill and a good sense of direction decide who ends up on the winners’ podium.

You and your horse – a strong team!
A good competition does not begin at the starting line. Brush your horse, pick out its hooves, feed it and decorate it for the big performance. After tough races, cool it down with water.

What awaits you:
• Experience an exciting Bibi & Tina adventure – with lots of great tasks and horse-filled moments!
• Play as Bibi, Tina or Alex – together with Sabrina, Amadeus, Maharaja and seven more horses that you can unlock.
• Discover the special highlight: carriage driving with races and slalom courses.
• Train for different tournament disciplines and collect points for the final.
• Ride checkpoint races, show jumping, slalom, flag races, ring jousting and trail races.
• Care for your horse by brushing it, feeding it, picking out its hooves, decorating it and cooling it down.
• Explore familiar places such as Martin's Farm, Falkenstein Castle, the Old Mill, Wolf's Gorge, the forest and Redwell Castle.
70010000117338.intro: A summer full of friendship, tournament excitement and horse-filled happiness!
70010000117338.name: Bibi & Tina – Ready, Set, Ride!

70010000117653.description:
Conrad wakes up in a hotel room with no memory of who he is or how he got there. What he does know: a deadly virus is tearing through cyberspace, Ankh Industries is behind it, and the clock is already ticking.

Navigate the cyberpunk streets of the City as Conrad, a rogue Courier piecing together the truth. Take on jobs from shady employers, pickpocket and loot to earn credits, and spend them on better guns, stronger armor, and high-tech upgrades. Hack your way through security systems using an intricate beam puzzle minigame, and dig deeper into the conspiracy threatening to bring the whole city down.

- Explore a richly detailed cyberpunk city in a brand new 8-bit adventure
- Earn and spend credits on weapons, armor, and tech upgrades
- Hack security systems with an intricate beam puzzle minigame
- Unravel the mystery behind Ankh Industries and the Courier virus
70010000117653.intro: He woke up with nothing. The city is about to have the same problem.
70010000117653.name: Courier

70010000120436.description:
Wake up Garfield from this nightmarish veggie filled 3D Platformer! The laziest cat is about to work hard in Garfield - Escape from Monday!

When you’re a lazy cat spending most of his time sleeping, having a nightmare can happen. But a nightmare full of vegetables and sugar-free candies, no way!

After Jon fed him spinach lasagnas inspired by Chef Monday’s recipe, Garfield falls into a deep sleep...

To wake up and reactivate his taste buds, the laziest cat in the world will have to explore worlds filled with enemies and eat a gigantic deal of lasagnas!

Fortunately Garfield can rely on Jon and his friends Odie, Arlene and Pookie. But also on his turkey, surfer and cowboy suits that will give him amazing skills!

- Move like a cat
Jump, climb the walls, curl up into a ball… you will always land on your feet!

- Embody Garfield in every form
Go airborne dressed as a turkey, slide on the water like a surfer and swing with your cowboy lasso!

- All the Garfield cast is here
Jon will be here to help you in your quest, along with Odie and Pookie. But beware Garfield's archenemies, Nermal and Squeak!

- Explore lively worlds
3 worlds and dozens of levels filled with enemies to fight and lasagnas to devour to regain the taste.

- The more you eat, the more rooms you edit!
Gather tons of delicious collectibles to keep your morale and help refurbish Jon's house with all kinds of surprising items.
70010000120436.intro: Garfield may be right not to trust vegetables…
70010000120436.name: Garfield - Escape From Monday

70010000121702.description:
In a city where memories fade, the truth must be reconstructed.

Welcome to Cyl-Hestia, a city-state built around Cerulyn, a mysterious blue flame with exceptional properties.
As the authorities are prepared to do anything to maintain their power, you play as Silas, a memorialist working for the independent newspaper The Voice.
Your mission: to gather fragments of memories to reconstruct the events obscured by the regime... and rekindle the flame of truth.

Investigate through memory

Explore the districts of Cyl-Hestia and collect Memory Records, short testimonies entrusted by its inhabitants. Combine them to reconstruct Remembrances and Mnemosyne Visions, revealing events buried in the collective memory.

Unmask the truth

Every discovery fuels The Voice's investigative work. With every published article, the world changes: surveillance intensifies, tensions arise and people become aware of what is happening.
Your progress has a significant narrative impact, gradually revealing the full extent of the manipulation at the heart of Cyl-Hestia.

Hack reality

You can interact with the environment via a sound hacking system.
Program punch cards to decipher encrypted records, unlock forgotten passages, or interact with ancient technological devices linked to the Flame.

A world between technology and poetry

In a world blending retro-futuristic science fiction, film noir atmosphere and mysticism, meet memorable characters, infiltrate the corridors of power, and explore the different levels of the city, from its forgotten slums to the sacred Spire tower.
70010000121702.intro: Play as a memorialist and investigate a dystopian city in this 3D adventure game.
70010000121702.name: Nocturne for Cyl-Hestia

70010000122476.description: Craft barricades and turrets with whatever you can find. But beware: relentless waves of enemies are coming to tear down everything you build.
70010000122476.intro: Physics meets tower defense in this chaotic party game up to 4 players.
70010000122476.name: Hack 'n' Stack

70010000123874.description:
WELCOME TO LEMURIA
A world inspired by Madagascar’s folklore. Once a paradise, it now suffers under the witch Raneny’s ruthless rule. Having grown tired of exploiting its people, she decided to host a huge concert with the island’s most famous band. You’re sent on a mission to fight back by rallying legendary musicians to your cause!

THE (BOGUS) PROPHECY CHOSE YOU
Dash through diverse biomes across Lemuria, save and befriend funky locals to form your crew, and jump over industrial platforming traps to become Lemuria’s number one band and finally face Raneny!

DANCING THROUGH JOYFUL CHAOS
Defeat Raneny’s minions in fast-paced combat, using hair-based powers and improvised weapons (slippers included) to fight epic and groovy boss battles and free the island!

HOP ON A FUN MUSICAL ROADTRIP 
Assemble a band with eccentric lemur artists, manage your tour bus through mini-games, and build your band’s popularity among locals to perform on bigger stages.
70010000123874.intro: Kalanoro is an action-adventure mixing platforming, combat and light management!
70010000123874.name: Kalanoro

70010000124354.description:
Every Soldier Has Their Specialty: Draft your forces among a wide variety of unique units, who each have a unique set of skills to exercise on the battlefield. Bully enemies by pushing and pulling them with the hearty Champion, strike and fade with the swift Cavalier, lay devastating traps with the talented Mage, and steal your opponent’s life essence and donate it to your companions as a Vampire healer.

Work Together or Die Alone: Units have complementary skill-sets that enable a pair to accomplish more together than they would alone. Well-coordinated skills can be greater than the sum of their parts!

Take the High Ground: Exploit the terrain on the battlefield to gain the upper hand. Hold defensive positions, close drawbridges on unsuspecting enemies, or launch over walls to outflank your foes.

Mark the Dawn of a New Era: Experience a fully-featured Campaign story that spans the continent, gathering companions to your Mercenary company, and take on challenges that grow ever greater. Fate has great (and terrible) things in store for you and your companions.

Seize Fate (and the Castle)!: Missions can have multiple victory conditions, and you only need to meet one to win! When you’re on the back-foot, look for an opportunity to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat.

Time Your Attacks Wisely: Each faction moves one unit at a time. You’ll have to react to the evolving state of the battlefield as you adapt to the changing situations.
70010000124354.name: Superstar Strategy

70010000129708.description:
Create the ultimate beachfront destination!

A game all about building a beautiful boardwalk.  Start with small stands and grow into a sprawling seaside paradise full of rides, high-end shops and fancy restaurants.


Build your Boardwalk
Dozens of shops to choose from

Build rides, restaurants, and stores, selling everything from sunglasses to vintage video games to sea glass art

Boost your visit rate by building the rides and restaurants people want


Manage your Promenade
Earn rewards as customers visit your shops

Upgrade each shop to bring in more revenue and serve customers faster

Expand your boardwalk and hire entertainers

Launch marketing campaigns to spread the word about your seaside destination


Combine Shops and Rides
Not enough space to serve your customers?  Combine shops to create bigger, better ones that can handle more customers at a time and earn you more money

Dozens of combination recipes to discover - movie theaters, bumper cars and more!


Other Features:
Navigate demand-changing weather events such as smog and rain

Donate to neighboring businesses – and earn rewards in return!

Participate in themed festivals to up your income and draw in big crowds

Invite VIPs and convince them to build their top-tier attractions on your boardwalk
70010000129708.intro: Design and expand your boardwalk by building rides, shops, and restaurants to draw in crowds.
70010000129708.name: Boardwalk Builders

70010000132907.description:
Rollick N' Roll combines fun physics with intuitive controls to deliver a joyful puzzle experience for all ages. Expand your collection by unlocking fun vehicles and playsets, but be prepared for a bit of chaos.

Key Features: 
• Intuitive controls - Press the button. See what happens. 
• Easy, medium or hard - More vehicles means more mayhem. 
• Need more? - Try some formidable time trials! 
• Chill tunes - Professionally composed soundtrack by Rest! 
• No training necessary - We hate tutorials too. 
• 25 challenging courses - 75 unique vehicles to collect.
70010000132907.intro: Marvelous marble runs, with a modern twist.
70010000132907.name: Rollick N' Roll

70010000133340.description:
Heroes of Magic & Cards is an inventive deckbuilding poker roguelike that rewards both careful buildcrafting and poker skills. Choose your class and chart your path across the world, from encounter to encounter, upgrading your deck, collecting relics, and refining your tactics to take down powerful bosses, earning powerful rewards!


YOUR DECK IS YOUR SWORD AND SHIELD

Cards are everything in Heroes of Magic & Cards! Your hand determines how much damage you can do and what abilities you can activate, such as building Rage or striking the enemy with Lightning! 

By collecting enchantments for your cards, you can improve their number value (change a “5” into a “6”), switch their suit (change a “diamond” into a “spade”), or apply special effects, including card-cloning and poison. By changing your cards’ suits or values you can continually improve your chances of drawing powerful poker-hands, which trigger devastating combo-effects.


POKER MEETS ROGUELIKE!

As you traverse the worldmap, discover relics, enchantments, consumable items, and expansions for your character’s natural class-abilities. Different discoveries and strategies will yield explosive synergies. At the same time, your inner poker-shark will feast!


FEATURES

• Choose from three heroes with access to over 90 abilities, changing the flow of the game in both subtle and spectacular ways. Cast Chain Lightning or Hellfire for massive damage! Use Sacrifice to trade health-points for more cards!
• Collect more than 40 different enchantments as you journey across the world, upgrading your cards and finding explosive synergies.
• Discover hundreds of powerful hidden relics that completely change the game, cutting your max-HP in exchange for vampiric healing, or doubling the power of odd-numbered cards in exchange for weakening the evens!
• Poker-hands such as straights, pairs, etc activate devastating combo-effects that leave opponents in ruin! Carefully manage your cards to pull off dazzling finishers!
• Play relaxing mini-games like fishing and gambling for extra rewards.
70010000133340.intro: Heroes of Magic & Cards is a roguelike deckbuilder with a poker twist.
70010000133340.name: Heroes of Magic & Cards

70010000134665.description:
A spooky, cosy 2.5D Platforming Halloween Adventure

It was supposed to be a normal halloween eve, but when 2 brother find an old spellbook, things turn chaotic as one gets turned into a Mummy and runs away. Time for a rescue missions.

Grab your magic wand and wizard costume to embark on a quest across 14 vibrant, action packed levels to break the curse and bring your brother home in this short but charming all hallows eve game. 

Key Features

14 handcrafted levels. Dash through neighbourhood streets, graveyard, eerie forests and more pack with spooky platforming hazards.

Magical Combat. Blast spooky creatures with your magic or use your slide or double jump to get past the monsters.

Fun mini games. Take a break from the main road to beat the mini challenges like a haunted volleyball match as you continue your journey.

Collect sweet treat to unlock stylish new hats and wands.

Cosy and Spooky aesthic. Enjoy a charming, non scary  Halloween game that's great for all ages.

Short and sweet. This game wont take hundreds of hours to beat.
70010000134665.intro: It's Halloween and two brothers wrongly read a cursed spell-book and one is instantly turned into a Mummy. Run, cast magic, win mini games and rescue your brother.
70010000134665.name: Spooky Tales and Mummy Trails

70050000070599.description:
Resurrection Core Edition continues to expand with new characters and new levels, delivered as part of the Season Pass. Each content drop introduces a new level alongside a new character to unlock and master, bringing fresh playstyles, abilities, and challenges to the game. As the season progresses, players will explore new environments, face new combat encounters, and expand their roster with powerful new heroes, keeping the experience evolving for returning players. 
*subject to change
70050000070599.name: Blood & Stone

70050000078497.description:
Bonus Skins for Rena and Soma
• Demon Blade Rena
• Scarlet Tiger Rena
• Azure Dragon Rena
• Demon Eye Soma
• Scarlet Tiger Soma
• Azure Dragon Soma

*This content is exclusively available as an early purchase bonus.
70050000078497.intro: Playable Characters: Rena & Soma Skins (3 types each)
70050000078497.name: Bonus Skins for Rena and Soma

70010000110118.description:
Welcome to The World’s Game in EA SPORTS FC™ 27.

Step into The Grounds‡‡, a social football playground where the streets meet the stadium. From Kickabouts and 1v1s to teaming up with friends in Clubs, connect with renowned football mentors, improve your abilities, and express yourself on and off the pitch.
Feel greater control in every game mode with more fluid, true-to-life gameplay, featuring dynamic corners, enhanced attacking awareness, player-focused defending tailored for competitive play, and more community-driven innovations.
Sign your next star in Manager Career through a rebuilt Transfer Market with realistic player values and active club bidding. Master new negotiation tactics, including performance and buy-back clauses, as Dynamic OVRs reflect player form, morale, and fitness across every club.
Immortalise your dream club in Football Ultimate Team™ with the brand-new FUT Gallery. Curate your favourite Player Items to grow your Gallery Level, earn rewards, and build your Club’s identity throughout the new football season.
Experience unrivalled authenticity in EA SPORTS FC™ 27, with match data from the world’s top leagues powering 21,000+ licensed players.

‡‡The Grounds mode, including Clubs, only available on Nintendo Switch™ 2 version.

This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.
70010000110118.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 27

70010000132613.description:
You enter an abandoned school hoping to uncover the truth behind its mysterious closure. Empty classrooms, silent hallways, and forgotten lockers hide clues to what really happened.

But before you can leave, the doors lock behind you.

Now your only goal is to escape. Explore the school, collect keys and uncover the dark secrets hidden within its walls. Just don't ignore the feeling that you're being watched.

Features:
>Explore a creepy abandoned school.
>Uncover the mystery behind the school's past.
>Experience atmospheric first-person horror.
>Evade the spirits that haunt the halls.
70010000132613.name: Missed Class: Horror

70010000133704.description:
Make your way through an icy obstacle course filled with slippery platforms, long jumps and freezing hazards. Stay focused as you leap across floating platforms and avoid falling into the frozen abyss.

Want a real challenge? Try Hardcore Mode, where every checkpoint is disabled. One slip, and it's back to the beginning.

FEATURES:
>Complete challenging ice-themed parkour levels.
>Jump across floating platforms and frozen terrain.
>Use checkpoints to save your progress.
>Take on Hardcore Mode with no checkpoints.
70010000133704.intro: Can you escape the frozen course?
70010000133704.name: Parkour Obby: Ice Escape

70010000128671.description:
Scritchy Scratchy is a super-satisfying scratch card incremental game where luck is your weapon, and glittering riches are just a scratch away.

Dive into a growing collection of scratchers, each with its own quirks, surprises, and sometimes downsides. Rip through tickets, uncover rare symbols, tweak your own luck, and chase absurd payouts.

Unlock Scratch Bot, your tireless mechanical friend who scratches and reveals the rewards for you. Turn your run into a full-blown jackpot engine as your balance shoots through the roof while you sit back and relax.

As you prosper, you’ll unlock upgrades that twist luck in your favor:

• Boosted odds and payouts
• Faster and easier scratching 
• New scratch card variants with unique rules

But power always comes with risk. Some cards tempt you with monstrous payouts at the cost of nasty penalties. Some offer steady income… others threaten your entire run. Will you play like a sensible adult or gamble like a degenerate in a neon casino?

When you’re ready for even more madness, Prestige to reset your run, gather Jack Points, and spend them on permanent upgrades that reshape your strategy. Build your own luck engine: Slow and steady, wildly explosive, or pure chaos.

Scritchy Scratchy is a dangerously satisfying progression casino, where every scratch is a little dopamine hit, and every run is one lucky break away from the big jackpot!
70010000128671.intro: Scritchy Scratchy is a super-satisfying scratch card incremental game. Buy stacks of scratch-offs, unlock auto-scratching, and chase massive jackpots. Will you play it safe or go all-in?
70010000128671.name: Scritchy Scratchy

70010000067527.description: Drop the pickaxe, grab a sword, and charge into a thrilling new adventure in Minecraft Dungeons II. Journey through unexplored lands and mysterious locations, in a quest to stop a new evil from causing chaos in not one, but two worlds! Clash with menacing foes in explosive encounters and fight your way through hordes of mobs that will do everything in their power to stop you from saving the day.
70010000067527.intro: Minecraft Dungeons II arrives on September 29!
70010000067527.name: Minecraft Dungeons II

70050000073155.description:
Included
Soul Cape
Blub Pet
4 Hero Skins
70050000073155.name: Deluxe DLC

70070000036346.description: Drop the pickaxe, grab a sword and charge into a thrilling new adventure in the Minecraft Dungeons II Deluxe Edition, featuring unique cosmetics, pre-order cosmetics and DLC 1+2 (when released)! Journey through unexplored lands in a quest to stop a new evil from causing chaos in not one, but two worlds. Clash with menacing foes in explosive encounters and fight your way through hordes of mobs that will do everything in their power to stop you from saving the day. The challenges will be tougher than ever, so face them solo or with up to 4 players in online or couch co-op. With a crisis upon us, will you and your friends rise to meet it?
70070000036346.intro: Minecraft Dungeons II arrives on 29 September!
70070000036346.name: Minecraft Dungeons II - Deluxe Edition

70010000100940.description:
Kong: Survivor Instinct is a 2.5D action-adventure game that combines realistic platforming, challenging combat, and metroidvania-style exploration during a thrilling quest of survival worthy of the Monsterverse franchise.

TRUE MONSTERVERSE ADVENTURE
A sudden Titan attack prompts massive evacuation efforts-but not everyone makes it to safety before the devastation ensues. Caught in the crossfire between battling monsters, many residents become trapped in the collapsing city—your only daughter among them!

Influence the Titans with Monarch tech and use their enormous strength to your advantage as you navigate a treacherous maze of collapsing buildings, toxic leaks, and raging fires. Scavenge for resources, weapons, and tools to solve environmental puzzles and defend yourself against both human and monster enemies.

FACE THE LEGENDARY KONG 
Explore and survive as you encounter Kong in all his majestic glory, face the formidable Abaddon, and confront other new and returning superspecies and Titans! Whether you scavenge through half-destroyed buildings or fight off mercenaries, these enormous monsters are nearby, directly or indirectly impacting your gameplay. Though the Titans pose a lethal threat, you can - and must - influence their behavior with the ORCA Σ, a new prototype inspired by Monarch’s technology.

ALAN JONAH RETURNS
Discover an official Monsterverse story set shortly after the events of Godzilla vs. Kong. Stand your ground against the Hyenas, a mercenary group led by Alan Jonah. Reemerging after the events of Godzilla: King of the Monsters, the former eco-terrorist leader returns in Kong: Survivor Instinct with a new villainous scheme.

A FATHER’S MISSION TO RESCUE HIS DAUGHTER
Take on the role of David, an oil rig worker braving a crumbling city to find your only child, Stacy. Make your way through the districts while encountering fellow survivors taking shelter among the rubble, mourning their loved ones or on the verge of giving up hope. Feel the awe-inspiring terror Titans bring upon a city  through the eyes of a father desperate to find his daughter!
70010000100940.intro: Survive the wonder and terror of the Titans in this official Monsterverse game.
70010000100940.name: Kong: Survivor Instinct

70050000046471.description: The Painted Red Crime Scene includes a Location, 6 Suspects, 4 Customisation Items, and 6 Tokens
70050000046471.name: Cluedo - Painted Red

70010000119771.description:
In this unique survival horror game, classical music intertwines with psychological terror to create an oppressive, chilling atmosphere. You play Alice, an ordinary girl who wakes up to find herself trapped in a bizarre, ever-changing world. A snowbound orphanage, monsters lurking in the shadows, and intricate puzzles—every step is fraught with danger and uncertainty.

To survive, you must gather supplies, evade pursuit, and uncover the secrets hidden in the darkness. But as the truth gradually comes to light, can you bear the cruel reality behind it all?

Gameplay features:
Action Shooting
Use a variety of firearms to defeat enemies

Map Exploration
Explore the eerie orphanage step by step, collecting items to unlock new areas while confronting unexplained changes that may occur without warning

Resource Management
Gather and make prudent use of limited resources, and do whatever it takes to survive

Puzzle Solving
Gather clues, solve a wide range of puzzles, and uncover the final truth
70010000119771.intro: A nightmare you cannot wake from, a pain that refuses to fade.
70010000119771.name: SEEK

70010000128470.description:
Down Pit is a relaxed mining platform game set across many off-world underground locations. You are a cuboid mining unit with a singular skill set sent out to extract ore from strange underground places.

Dig.
Get Paid.
Upgrade.
Relax, maybe.
Collect.
Go Back Down Pit.
Dig.

Find your favourite location and dig all the ore. Return to Ore Processing and get paid.  All the pit locations from The Depot can be remined infinitely, for free - no unlocks, bail at any time with no penalty. Dig in your favourite mine again and again, and get paid.

Yes to Digging.
Yes to Getting Paid.

No to enemies, combat, secrets, story, unlocks, card games, skill trees, pets, fishing, timers, npc interruptions, never ending dialogue, walls of text, power of friendship, ancient evil force, lost parents, lost items, lost love, missing pets, self-asteem whining, neuroses listing, dot dot dotting, time wasting, anime, pixel art, anime inspired pixel art, faff.

Dig. And Get Paid.

There’s unlimited money to make with just you and all those mining areas to destroy, one block at a time. You arrive ready to mine, all equipment supplied, all ready to work. All the money is yours because only you will mine it out.

Teleport Down Pit is to the left (Dig).
Ore Processing is to the right (Get Paid).

Lots of other utilities are in The Depot but be careful not to get too distracted, some are costly, some will drain your time. Warning: the poker game does not work and never will (it is a long term programming issue caused by a fool).

Dig. And Get Paid.
70010000128470.name: Down Pit

70010000129849.description:
After the events of a shadow-beast invasion on a seaside town, complete villager quests and find hidden diaries to understand your role in this mysterious character-driven story.

SEASONS OF ILLISOR

From The Dancing Moon Inn to the Stoknel Swamp regions. Explore both hand-crafted and procedural zones with seasonal and weather effects, providing different moods as time progresses throughout the game.

UNRAVEL THE MYSTERY

Discover your role in this story as you complete a variety of quests and collect hidden diaries. Unravel the mystery of the missing teenagers and their entanglement between the tea-brewing Magisters and the frightening shadow-beasts!

MEET THE VILLAGERS

Learn more about Ïllisor and it’s villagers by doing activities like questing, crafting, farming, cooking, and fishing. Help rebuild the town from the recent invasion and get them back on their feet!

Will you discover your purpose in the world of Ïllisor and find a way back home? Track down those pesky teenagers? Or will you simply enjoy your time staying at The Dancing Moon?
70010000129849.intro: Tales from the Dancing Moon is a mystery adventure game inspired by British culture and portal-fantasy novels.
70010000129849.name: Tales from The Dancing Moon

70010000130717.description:
1. Hatch Eggs: Obtain juvenile monsters of random rarities
2. Raise Monsters: Wait for juvenile monsters to grow up
3. Sell Monsters: Sell monsters after they mature
4. Collect: Complete 100 × 2 monster handbook entries
5. Music: Enjoy relaxing Lo-fi music while idling
6. Offline Progress: Monsters continue to grow and earn income even while you're away
70010000130717.intro: A relaxing idle monster collection game (with offline progress). Features 200 monster entries and 10 Lo-fi tracks.
70010000130717.name: Monster Nursery

70010000132993.description:
This pack includes the games: Rally Rock ´N Racing and Hypercar Racing.

Rally Rock ´N Racing

In Rally Rock 'N Racing, you’ll enjoy a wide variety of natural environments, such as deserts, snow-covered mountains, forests... where you can show your skill at the wheel, competing against everyone to become the fastest. The game has several modes, such as Championship, Time Trial, Arcade, and 4-player multiplayer.

Hypercar Racing

In Hypercar Racing you'll enjoy the dirtiest, fastest, and most spectacular races at speeds over 200 Mp/h, avoiding multiple collisions against 8 adversaries. The game has different modes, such as Championship, Arcade, and 4-player multiplayer.

Online leader board where you can compare your best times with those of your friends and players from around the world.

Features:

- Wide variety of tracks.
- Multi-player with 4 players.
- Realistic driving physics.
- Lots of Rock 'N Roll music.
 -Online ranking
70010000132993.intro: Enjoy 2 games in 1 with this irresistible speed games pack!
70010000132993.name: Rally & Hypercar Bundle

70010000133372.description:
You wake up in a dark hallway with no memory of how you got there. The exit is locked by an ancient curse, and the only way to break it is to find every cursed voodoo doll hidden throughout the endless corridors.

But something else roams the halls.

Features
>Explore eerie, cursed hallways.
>Collect voodoo dolls to lift the curse.
>Experience tense first-person horror.
>Survive a terrifying presence stalking the halls.
70010000133372.name: Screaming Halls: Horror

70010000090753.description:
Rainbow Island CS is a collection of several home ports of the arcade game Rainbow Islands.

　In addition to the popular 8 and 16-bit versions, the collection includes the never-released-on-cartridge MegaDrive/Genesis version. With 24 quick-save/load slots for each version and a feature that displays the location of the diamonds, there's never been a better time to experience it. It also includes a feature that lets you start the game in a powered-up state.

The PC Engine version is based on the NES version and features a main theme arranged for FM sound by Yukiharu Urita, as well as an ending theme composed by Norihiro Furukawa, both Zuntata (Taito's sound team) alumni.

What is Rainbow Islands?
Rainbow Islands is an arcade action game released by Taito in 1987 where the player controls Bubby or Bobby, using their rainbow magic as both weapons and platforms to climb and reach the goal at the highest point of each stage.

[Story] 
At the end of the previous game, Bubble Bobble, the bubble dragons Bub and Bob had rescued their parents and girlfriends and returned to their human forms of Bubby and Bobby.
Several years after those events, Bubby and Bobby return to their ancestral home, Rainbow Islands, in search of treasure, but end up entangled in another devious plot!
It seems that their true nemesis, the Boss of Shadow, has since resumed his evil machinations. Bubby and Bobby's path is blocked by various enemies, but with the “rainbow magic” given to them by their parents, they bravely continue their adventurous journey.

*The story described here is based on the Mega Drive and PC Engine versions. The content differs slightly in the Family Computer, Nintendo Entertainment System, and SEGA Master System versions.

Contents
・Rainbow Islands (Family Computer version) 
・Rainbow Islands (Nintendo Entertainment System version) 
・Rainbow Islands (Sega Master System version) 
・Rainbow Islands Extra (JP Mega Drive version) Rainbow Island Extra (US/EU Mega Drive/Genesis version) 
・Rainbow Islands (PC Engine CD-ROM² version)

*The background music for the Family Computer, Mega Drive, and PC Engine CD-ROM² versions uses the main theme based on the NES version.
70010000090753.intro: Experience 6 different versions of the magical world of Rainbow Islands! That comical place full of dreams is back!
70010000090753.name: Rainbow Islands CS

70010000099839.description:
■■ About the Game ■■

Heroic Songs: the Remix! is an Idol × City-Building Simulation Game where you help develop a land known as the Void while guiding the main heroine, Akari Sunohara, on her journey to become an idol. Build roads and facilities, attract new residents, and transform this desolate world into a vibrant Fanctuary worthy of the spotlight!

● A Diverse Lineup of Buildings
With over 50 unique buildings, you'll have plenty of ways to shape your city!
- Basic Facilities such as houses to attract Fans, and roads to connect your buildings
- Production Facilities, placed around resource tiles and visited by Fans to gather materials
- Processing Facilities, which convert one type of resource into another as a result of Fan visits
- Recreational Facilities, where resources are spent to generate Likes, a key progression resource
You can also earn Likes through Tours, or the rhythm-based Concerts described below.

● Idol Stages
By constructing personal stages, idols will perform for their Fans by singing and dancing in town! Idols with stages become available for Concerts and Tours, and will boost the surrounding buildings whenever they’re present. 

As idols gain experience from performances, their levels rise—enhancing those building effects even further! You can also assign skill points to customize how their influence spreads across your city. ;)

● Concerts
Concerts are short, 30-second rhythm games. Keep in time with the music to hit the target score and clear the stage! Successful Concerts will unlock new story content, boost idol and Fan experiences, and provide rewards. Some idols will also unlock alternate stage outfits as you progress through the game.

● A Wild Yet Heartfelt Story Unfolds!
Progress through successful concerts, construction projects, and city development to unlock new chapters in the story.
Follow Akari Sunohara—an ordinary girl with a love for idols—as she discovers her true calling. Dive deeper into each of the five main heroines in dedicated Character Stories, and experience each idol’s unique charm!

■ Characters ■
● Protagonist (You)
You’re the one who was transported to the Void alongside Akari. As the central figure in this world, your role is to support Akari and the other idols on their journey.

● Akari Sunohara / voiced by: Seika Hirose
An ordinary girl with an extraordinary love for idols. She possesses the innate potential to become one herself, and must step into the spotlight to find a way home.
At first, she struggles with doubt and frustration, but grows through her encounters with veteran idols and her fans in the fantasy worlds.

● Ruri Tsukuyomi / voiced by: Risae Matsuda
The Ultimate Idol, reigning at the top with an overwhelming presence and voice. Her legacy echoes throughout the various fantasy worlds Akari explores.

● Lynalelle Singulant / voiced by: Hitomi Sekine
The idol of Seven Falls, a fantasy-themed world. She’s a king, an idol, and a passionate idol superfan all in one!

● Haru / voiced by Yuka Amemiya
The idol of Discordia, a sci-fi-themed world. She’s a trusted senior to Akari, but seems to be hiding some complicated circumstances.

● Kaguya / voiced by Risae Matsuda
The idol of Karan Ashihara, a world with a traditional Japanese aesthetic. As the wild and fearsome Behemoth of Befoulment, she stands in Akari’s path as a powerful rival.
70010000099839.intro:
Build a Sanctuary for Idols Across Fantasy Worlds!
A City-Building × Idol Simulation Game
70010000099839.name: Heroic Songs: the Remix!

70010000117983.description:
Welcome to Sesame Street! A place to play, laugh and grow. 

From the moment you arrive, there’s so much to do. Join Elmo, Tango and the rest of your Sesame Street friends around the neighbourhood! 

Walk around with Grover, plant a magical giant beanstalk in Abby’s Garden, find useful tools and rubber ducks in the Community Garden with Bert & Ernie, and work on your number and puzzle skills in Count von Count’s Mansion. Or cook, mix and laugh along with Cookie Monster in his Foodie Truck! Some quests may take a few tries, but you’ll work together to find a way to make the streets a brighter and happier place for everyone. 

Make yourself at home! Decorate your house, unlock new mini-games, access exciting new areas of the Street, or throw and unforgettable block party. Spend time with Tango, your cheerful and furry helper or enjoy the whole adventure together with family and friends in local co-op play.  

The fun and exploration never ends on Sesame Street!  

JOIN THE NEIGHBORHOOD: Create your own character and join Elmo, Tango, Abby and their friends on Sesame Street.  

EXPLORE THE STREET: Start at your apartment, stop by Big Bird’s cozy nest, play at the Count’s Mansion, and unlock more places. 

BRING EVERYONE TOGETHER: Help the community by going on cooking, photography, and even farming quests solo or in co-op. 

DISCOVER AND GROW: Use rewards to decorate your home, unlock new mini-games and access exciting new areas. 

TRAVEL WITH TANGO: Take care of Tango just like she’ll take care of you as she helps you get around.  

THE STAGE IS YOURS: Choose from the colorful backdrops, lights, and other cool special effects for the main stage.
70010000117983.intro: Move in and feel right at home and celebrate with your Sesame Street friends.

Dive into a lovingly crafted world and explore the adventurous surroundings at your own pace.

Create your own style for you and your horse with numerous customization options and a wide selection of carefully designed color combinations.

All of this is accompanied by an atmospheric original soundtrack composed by Grammy®-winning musician Winifred Phillips.

From the creators of the HORSE CLUB Adventures series - Wild River Games

Based on the HORSE CLUB franchise by the German toy brand Schleich®

70010000107082.description:
She has one special power: she can see into people's heart and heal emotions through magic!

YOUR DAILY LIFE AS A WITCH-BAKER IN PARIS!
You play as Lunne, who has just arrived in the city! Each day is split into three phases:

-Daytime, where Lunne manages her bakery and serves clients with her team of friends.
-Evening, where Lunne explores Paris, builds relationships, discovers the city's secrets and goes inside her friends' troubled heart.
- Night, where Lunne rests, improves her magic, decorates her bakery and spends time in her cosy atelier.

The story progresses through the days as you earn experience, money, and fame, meet new friends and heal their heart.

A COLORFUL PARIS IN A JOYFUL ADVENTURE!
Once your work day is done, you can visit several districts of Paris to meet with main characters, engage in activities to learn new skills, buy books for new recipes, etc.
From typical streets of famous districts like Montmartre and the Grands Boulevards, to more intimate promenades known only by locals, Paris has many wonders to discover.Each district has its own characters, activities and shops!

A STORY ABOUT EMOTIONS AND VULNERABILITY
For some people, their emotion is locked away so strongly than Lunne needs to go inside their heart to help them. She enters their "Heart Palace", a magical space where emotions and thoughts take shape. Lunne needs to guide the personified Emotion back to the heart.

Inside the Heart Palace, Lunne discovers the person's deepest struggles and finds the key ingredient she needs to make a bread that will heal them!
70010000107082.intro: The Witch's Bakery is a cozy Adventure RPG about a joyful witch who opens her bakery in modern Paris!

70010000109109.description:
Step back into Andy’s room with Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and more classic characters in Toy Story: Retro Roundup! This five-game collection features console and handheld versions of four early Toy Story titles, as well as A Bug’s Life. All the games have been upgraded with new features, quality-of-life improvements, and an overflowing toy chest of behind-the-scenes content. Revisit the ‘90s and early 2000s hits you loved and share these titles with a new generation of Toy Story fans. 

Play Toy Story (1995), Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue! (1999), Toy Story 2 (1999), Buzz Lightyear of Star Command (2000), Toy Story Racer (2001) and A Bug’s Life (1998). Includes 11 total versions of the games across console and handheld. The games have been enhanced with quality-of-life improvements, including Rewind, Rex’s Cheat Codes, and more. Use Rewind to retry mistakes when you miss a jump across Andy’s shelves or take too many hits from the angry, wind-up robot. Unlock game-specific enhancements like unlimited lives or invincibility with Rex’s Cheat Codes.

Step inside Digital Eclipse’s behind-the-scenes experience, featuring exclusive interviews withJason Katz – Head of Story, Pixar, Jim Hanks – Voice Actor, Luigi Priore – VP and GM, Disney & Pixar Games, and Jon Burton – Founder, TT Games, who helped bring these adventures to life. Explore a richly-detailed virtual museum filled with rare design documents, vintage development photos, and archival content. Listen to your favorite songs from the games in the Music Player, where we’ve rounded up the soundtracks from every game in the collection. 

FEATURES

- Play five classic games, including four Toy Story games and A Bug’s Life. Includes 11 total versions of the games across console and handheld.

- Enhancements and quality-of-life improvements make the games easier to learn and understand for gamers of all ages. 

- Use Rewind to fix your mistakes. Messed up a jump? Took too many hits? Simply hold a button and scrub back to before you made that mistake and try again. 

- Includes a behind-the-scenes experience featuring new interviews with Jason Katz – Head of Story, Pixar, Jim Hanks – Voice Actor, Luigi Priore – VP and GM, Disney & Pixar Games, and Jon Burton – Founder, TT Games. 

- Explore the virtual museum filled with rare design documents, vintage development photos, and archival content. 

- Use Rex’s Cheat Codes! Get unlimited lives, invincibility, or unlock all the characters or levels.

- Learn the game with enhanced How to Play instructions, then hone your skills in Practice Mode.

- Listen to the Music Player, which includes the complete soundtrack for every game in the collection.
70010000109109.intro: Play along with classic Toy Story characters in the ultimate 5-game collection.
70010000109109.name: Disney/Pixar Toy Story: Retro Roundup!

70010000109114.description:
Reopen the toy chest and saddle up as Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie in Toy Story 3 Complete Edition, a 3D adventure based on the hit 2010 animated film, Toy Story 3. The updated game features improved graphics and a few new surprises in store. Play through authentic moments from the movie in Story Mode, or drop into the wild west sandbox of Woody’s Roundup in Toy Box Mode. 

In Story Mode, swap between Woody, Buzz, and Jessie as you play through iconic scenes from the film, including the train rescue, Operation Playtime, surviving the junkyard, and more. Harness each character's unique abilities, whether you need to swing on Woody’s pull string or use Buzz’s strength to throw the other toys long distances. You can even play in two-player co-op. 

Step out of Story Mode and into the sandbox in Toy Box Mode. This fan-favorite, customizable mode drops you into the wild west of Woody’s Roundup. Like Story Mode, you play as Woody, Buzz, or Jessie, but in Toy Box Mode you can play however you want! Characters around town give you quests to complete, so you can earn gold and spend it on personalizing the town your way. Build, decorate and customize the buildings, dress up the townsfolk, and more.

Toy Story 3 Complete Edition also includes content that was previously restricted to certain versions of the game. Players can now play as the Evil Emperor Zurg in Toy Box Mode, and can access four additional Theme Packs to decorate their Toy Box. Toy Story 3 Complete Edition also features upgraded graphics, resolution, and framerate.

FEATURES

- Toy Story 3 Complete Edition brings back a fan-favorite game. 

- Relive key moments from the movie in Story Mode from Andy's room to Sunnyside Daycare.

- Swap between Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie, each of with different abilities you’ll need to complete each level. 

- Dive into the sandbox in Toy Box Mode. Take on missions for your fellow toys, dress up the townsfolk, decorate buildings, and much more. 

- Play with a friend in local, two player co-op. Available in Story Mode or Toy Box Mode. 

- All versions now include previously exclusive content, such as the ability to play as Emperor Zurg in Toy Box Mode.
70010000109114.intro: Play as Woody, Buzz, and Jessie in the Complete Edition of the 3D adventure.
70010000109114.name: Disney/Pixar Toy Story 3 Complete Edition

Medieval Paris, Where the Tolling Bells Herald the End
1499. Paris is engulfed in flames as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows.
Trevor Belmont, the hero who defeated Dracula, ventures into the burning streets with his daughter, Rose Belmont. Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, they hunt down the beasts bleeding from the looming castle.

Rose is soon swept up in the dark conspiracy that lurks beneath. Will she succeed in saving Paris from devastation?

Satisfying Whip Action
Castlevania's iconic whip action is more satisfying than ever!
Crack your whip to move around freely like a trapeze artist!
Master the whip mechanics and be creative to pounce on your prey like a wolf in fast-paced combat!

Diverse Bosses and the Arcana System
Face-off against legendary bosses including Death, Medusa and Carmilla in addition to enigmatic new bosses such as Joan of Arc.
Once defeated, bosses are sealed into Rose's tarot cards, turning them into Arcana - use their skills to cast spells and obtain unique special actions

Customize Your Battle Style with Weapons and Relics
Customize Rose’s battle style by using a variety of equipment, including weapons spanning seven distinct categories and Relics that trigger powerful effects through both offense and defense.
Combine equipment you discover through exploration to create your own playstyle!

Iconic Castlevania Atmosphere, Reimagined in New Stages
From iconic Gothic aesthetics to vivid, refined visuals, the game presents a fresh take on the world of Castlevania.
Explore maps filled with both new features and familiar elements inspired by classic Castlevania titles.

Experience Tales of Eternia, remastered for the first time ever.

• An Epic Journey with Two Worlds at Stake
Journey to Eternia, a world split into two isolated realms, Inferia and Celestia.
In the remote Inferian village of Rasheans, Reid Hershel and his childhood friend Farah Oersted meet a mysterious girl named Meredy. During their journey to discover Meredy's origins, the group discovers that a collision called the "Great Fall" threatens both Inferia and Celesita.
Harnessing the power of elemental spirits known as the Greater Craymels, Reid and his companions embark on an epic journey to save the two realms from catastrophe.

• Exhilarating Battle Action with Speed and Freedom
Featuring the Aggressive Linear Motion Battle System (A-LMBS), which enables diverse Arte usage, continued combos, and coordination with each unique party member.

Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin. 

◆ Cinematic pixel art
What if FINAL FANTASY had continued to push the limits of pixel art? The first FINAL FANTASY to join the HD‑2D lineup, FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE delivers a visually striking experience that feels both nostalgic and new, enhanced by dynamic camera angles and pixelized 3D models that make every moment more dramatic and immersive.

◆ A return to the familiar
A classic RPG adventure unfolds in a world filled with beloved FINAL FANTASY elements—airships, crystals, espers and moogles woven into the fabric of the story, and so much more.

◆ Strategic turn-based battles
Exploit enemy weaknesses to stagger them—breaking their defenses to seize extra turns and gain the upper hand with powerful Resonance attacks in cinematic battles shaped by smart choices.

◆ FINAL FANTASY legends
Bolster your team with Visions, echoes of beloved FINAL FANTASY characters, who fight alongside you with unique skills and abilities for deep party customization.

◆ Hours of side content to discover
The world is full of secrets, including the wandering swordmaster Gilgamesh, a Colosseum with deadly monsters and rewards to match, the Chamber of Arms with formidable foes sealed within legendary weapons, and a showdown with Ultima Weapon.

70010000131669.description:
The cursed tower rises before you: a colossus whose walls pulse with neon light and echoes of ancient battles. Deep within await the 5 Generals of the Demon King, surrounded by their infernal hordes. They have kidnapped the Saint to offer her as a sacrifice and open a portal that will allow their master to return to this world. Your mission is to plunge into the unknown and rescue her before the Dark Lord’s plans come to pass.

Control your flippers, keep the ball in play, and ascend a tower filled with enemies, secrets, and increasingly intense challenges.

Each room presents a new challenge: destroy enemies, activate powers through cards, and manage your resources to survive. As you progress, you’ll master the physics, discover hidden mechanics and secret routes, and find the keys needed to reach the true ending. Only those who explore carefully, adapt their strategy, and perfect their technique will unravel the secrets of the tower. How far can you go?

- Two game modes: Arcade Mode for quick sessions, and Adventure Mode, where saved items allow for progression.
- Co-Op Mode: Play with the help of a friend. Using the target cursor, they can select cards, defeat enemies, destroy attacks, and collect upgrades.
- Enter 10 challenge stages featuring bosses that will test your precision and skill as you discover their weak points.

70010000131669.intro: In Pinballoid Crush, classic pinball evolves into an arcade experience with adventure and strategy elements.
70010000131669.name: Pinballoid Crush

70010000130599.description:
Tarot Tokens is a strategic tile game inspired by the Fools journey through the major arcana of the tarot. Placing Tarot Tokens crafts your journey from four key aspects of the major arcana of the tarot: family, morals, conflict, hope.

Win With Virtues
The aim of Tarot Tokens is to build your three virtues up and keep them nicely balanced by making wise, or seemingly foolish choices, along the way. Run out of any virtue and the journey ends. Reach the end by taking all the steps and reflect on your journey - learn to see pass the numbers and embrace your whole journey.

The Fool
Every game starts with The Fool already placed. Your choices between the Tarot Tokens steers your journey, with the help of the Fools Abilities every few turns. Your journey through the life challenges of placing tokens shape the Fools path that is always different, always yours.

Silence Is Golden
Tarot Tokens has no sound of any kind, no music, no effects, nothing. Enjoy the silence or bring your own noise, much like when using real tarot cards for a reading. Feedback is visual only and there are options to tone it down if you find it a bit much.

Not A Deck Builder
You play with all 22 tokens of the major arcana, every game. A randomly selected number of tokens are offered to you each turn, except The Fool who is used only once at the start of every game. All tokens interact with some other tokens on the board. Each token has its own unique effect with most generating virtues in addition to other token interactions. 

Follow Your Path
Play your favourite token as often as you want, if it is available that turn. Or play highly tactically to gain maximum virtue and be really efficient, although you might just be missing out. Every token is always unlocked and randomly chosen every turn - no token fixing or token reading goes on (even though it might feel that way if your journey feels off).

A Hex On You!
Tarot Tokens uses a hex grid in shameless violation of the four sided card format of the tarot. The essence of the tarot is faithfully preserved in a hex shape with on-demand help explaining virtues, adjacency information, and a brief description of the significance of that tarot token in the context of the Fools journey. Hex grids are still over rated though!
70010000130599.name: Tarot Tokens

Authorized by original developer Matthew Smith, this reboot of the 1983 classic combines the distinctive and challenging gameplay of MANIC MINER with modern graphics, improved controls, newly arranged music, and extensive historical bonus content.

Step back into the role of miner Willy and take on 20 legendary levels filled with deadly creatures, clever jumps, and tricky obstacles. Collect all the items before your oxygen runs out and master one of the most challenging platformers of all time.

Climb the global MANIC MINER online leaderboard and become number one in one of the toughest classics in gaming history!

This re-release offers two modes: Enjoy the original pixel art look, or discover all the levels in atmospheric HD graphics with elaborate parallax scrolling, dynamic lighting effects, and lovingly designed backgrounds.

Thanks to modernized controls, MANIC MINER plays more precisely and smoothly than ever before, without losing any of the original’s high standards.

The classic has also been reimagined musically: The works by Johann Strauss and Edvard Grieg, which were already featured in the original, have been rearranged to give the adventure a contemporary sound.

In addition, the collection includes a comprehensive interactive history that documents the exciting story behind the creation of MANIC MINER from the early 1980s to the present day.

Features

•    Beautiful new backgrounds with parallax scrolling and atmospheric effects

70010000100155.description:
What is Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure?
A single-player, tilt-based platformer game for everyone. A heartwarming physics-based adventure for all ages. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

Why do we need Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure?
Marupoyo is a charismatic, simple alternative to complex heroes, featuring a clean art style perfect for all ages. It offers the ideal mix of relaxing vibes and fun challenges. It's a unique game for everyone to enjoy alone or with the family.

What kind of players can enjoy the game?
The game is designed for everyone, having an easy  accessibility in the controls (just need to tilt the controller to play!) and with only one action: brake. Also, the Family Mode adds elements to avoid players dying, allowing players that like cozy games to play and have fun. However, the gamer mode brings more speed, deathly elements and adds lots of challenges to the game, such as beating the clock, getting the badge for not losing lives or the Pro player badge for not using brakes.

Story Summary
Marupoyo is a unique chick born so round he can’t walk — he can only roll! Though initially mocked for his clumsiness, he becomes the village’s only hope when a massive tornado scatters his family across the kingdom.

Guided by the Queen of Nature, Marupoyo rolls through forests, icy mountains, sandy deserts and volcanoes to stop an exiled Alchemist whose experiments are destroying the world. Along the way, he rescues his siblings and proves that his unique way of moving is actually a superpower - always rolling forward! Without fear, he will restore peace and become the kingdom's greatest hero.

Gameplay Elements
★ Physics Movements: tilt the board to move game elements.
★ Walls and floors: Colliding, Movable, walk-through and Bumpy.
★ Adversaries: Path Followers that may bump or defeat you.
★ Dangers: Cliffs, Holes, Water, Lava and Corruption will be hazardous.
★ Natural Hurdles: such as Water streams, Ice, Grass and Bumpy Mushrooms.
★ Family Mode: Cotton Clouds will cover most of the dangers in the levels.
★ Gamer Mode: Normal gameplay with all the challenges available.

Collectables and Challenges
★ Rescue all the family members during your trip. Once saved, you can visit them in your hometown and improve bonds with corn.
★ Win against the clock in Time Attack challenges in every level and earn extra Corn prizes (and a badge to be proud of!)
★ Collect all the Corn within a level and win an extra Corn prize (and again, medals for you!)
★ Find all the music tracks hidden in the game.

Family game mode
★ This mode is a bit slower, takes deathly stuff and adds clouds to avoid falling, reducing frustration.
★ Clouds will be bouncy, to keep it fun.
★ This mode eliminates the visual fear of younger players. (I don’t want to fall into lava)

Accessibility
★ Motion Sick toggle, to quit floor movement on screen and reduce dizziness. 
★ Sound volume split with Music, VO and Sound Effects.
70010000100155.intro: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Control Marupoyo as he rolls through levels, avoiding obstacles and rescuing his lost siblings.
70010000100155.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure

[About the Game]
Befriend a Medley of Monsters

70010000098134.description:
Leap into a lost world of mechanical wonders and embark on a hopping adventure with the adorable Labi! Use a wide range of jumps and moves to traverse this colorful cartoon world, meet squishy creatures and clumsy robots, and uncover its hidden secrets.

GAMEPLAY

Labi is all about powerful, precise jumps!

Installing a thruster module instead of a mobility module by mistake gave Labi the shortest yet most powerful legs of any robot. With those mighty legs, Labi can perform a Leg Launch and blast off like a cannonball, Stomp enemies with tremendous force, or spring off walls.

And it gets even better! Once Labi finds the Warp Ball, you can instantly teleport to wherever it lands. To overcome obstacles and solve puzzles, plan your route carefully and combine Running, Stomping, Dashing, and Double Jumping to find the best way forward. When danger strikes, Dash like a ninja and rely on your quick reflexes to dodge whatever comes your way.

GOALS

The core directive of Labi’s program: seek FREEDOM!

Collect Batteries scattered throughout each level. Some lie in plain sight along the main path, while others require a little extra exploration. At the end of each level, you will receive Gems based on the number of Batteries you collected. Gather enough Gems to unlock new areas.

Collect every Battery in a level to unlock its Time Trial. Complete the challenge to earn the level’s final Gem—a worthy prize for serious challengers!

FEATURES

Every being, organic or synthetic, has value—even robots. Cute ones, at least!

An enemy one moment may become your friend the next. Despite their intimidating appearance, enemies do not mind Labi bouncing on their heads. Manipulate, provoke, or even protect them, then use their abilities to complete levels in ways you never imagined.

STORY

An imaginary yet strangely realistic post-apocalyptic world.

Where did all these robots come from? Who created them? And why do those seemingly pointless assembly lines continue running forever?

Explore a fantastical world of giant fruit and adorable robots while uncovering a heartfelt story about humanity and identity. Journey through colorful, vibrant environments, interact with an intriguing cast of characters, and gradually piece together the history of this world. Help our little hero discover what truly matters, reveal everything that has been lost, and befriend a whole cast of totally huggable characters!

70050000071768.description:
Downloadable content for DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World.

The metallic ring is a special item you can use while out exploring to turn all the enemies in the area into metal monsters* or hunter mechs. You can use the metallic ring as many times as you like, but you'll have to wait 30 in-game minutes between uses.

The effects of the metallic ring wear off after some time has passed or if you leave your current area.

Depending on when you use the metallic ring, you may encounter monsters that provide far more experience points than otherwise available at that stage in the story. So whether you're just starting out or have already completed the main story, you can use the metallic ring to quickly and effectively boost your monsters' experience points.

*The metal monsters are metal slimes, liquid metal slimes and metal king slimes.

- This content does not include the main game of DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World.
- This content and other bonuses are available as part of the DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION and the DLC 4-ITEM SET. Please bear this in mind to avoid making duplicate purchases.
- You can claim this content by selecting "Check Additional Content" from the in-game menu screen.
- The content will be available to use only after the second main area of story has been completed.
70050000071768.name: Metallic Ring

70010000080761.description:
***The aroma of bread in memories... In this moment, let's start anew!***

This is a world where bread is gradually being forgotten.

Until one day, in the corner of the world, an accidental explosion triggered by the main character Chaya, who was forced to stay in a rundown town where she is unfamiliar with the little store owner Effie to rebuild her bakery.

And the good smell from the insignificant oven is - the almost lost delicious food, **BREAD**!

## Collect materials in areas with your style!

Use your weapon and skills to create a path!

There're multiple weapons to choose from.

They all have a unique skilltree to make your own playstyle!

* Multiple areas with different theme and challenges!
* The locals are cute but also dangerous!
* Rare materials! What bread can they make?

## Delicious bread for the bakery!

Sell breads in your own bakery!

* Set up the rack of breads for most outcome!
* Customers are in need! Help them or lose the opportunity!
* Make sure there're breads to sell!
* Clean up that floor, or you might lose some money!

## Develop deserted town, meet new friends!

With power of bread, new possibilities are opened!

* New friends will join the town with your progress!
* Research and upgrade the recipes to become top rated shop!
* Make deserted town great by developing new budlings!
70010000080761.intro: A bread revolution across the world now begins!
